name: dashboard-ai-boilerplate
description: Boilerplate dashboard admin ber-AI — API-first, SSR, modular, database-agnostic, self-hosted

scripts.bootstrap: bun run db:codegen && bun run modules:sync && bun run db:codegen && bun run layout:variants
scripts.build: bun run bootstrap && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.check: bun run bootstrap && bun run lint && bun run typecheck
scripts.ci:sync-pure: bun run bootstrap && git diff --exit-code && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)"
scripts.db:generate: bun run bootstrap && bun run --cwd packages/db generate
scripts.db:matrix: docker compose --profile matrix up -d --wait && bun run scripts/db-matrix.ts
scripts.db:matrix:docker: docker compose --profile matrix up -d --wait && docker run --rm --network dashboard-ai-boilerplate_default --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD":/w -w /w -e MATRIX_MYSQL_URL=mysql://app:app@mysql:3306/app -e MATRIX_MARIADB_URL=mysql://app:app@mariadb:3306/app -e MATRIX_POSTGRES_URL=postgres://app:app@postgres:5432/app oven/bun:1.4 bun run scripts/db-matrix.ts
scripts.proof:backup:docker: docker compose up -d --wait mysql && PROOF_MODE=docker sh scripts/ci/backup-restore-proof.sh
scripts.proof:e2e:docker: docker compose up -d --wait mysql && docker run --rm --network dashboard-ai-boilerplate_default -v "$PWD":/w -w /w -e DB_DIALECT=mysql -e DATABASE_URL=mysql://app:app@mysql:3306/app -e INTEGRATION=1 -e E2E=1 -e PROOF_ONLY=M5,E2E -e PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/ms-playwright --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -v "$(command -v bun)":/usr/local/bin/bun:ro mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.58.2-noble bash -c "bun run bootstrap && bun run --cwd packages/db migrate && BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@example.test BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD='bootstrap admin password' bun run db:seed && BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@example.test BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD='bootstrap admin password' sh scripts/ci/m1-proof.sh"
scripts.proof:m1:docker: docker compose up -d --wait mysql && docker run --rm --network dashboard-ai-boilerplate_default --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD":/w -w /w -e DB_DIALECT=mysql -e DATABASE_URL=mysql://app:app@mysql:3306/app -e INTEGRATION=1 -e PROOF_ONLY oven/bun:1.4 sh -c "bun run bootstrap && bun run --cwd packages/db migrate && BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@example.test BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD='bootstrap admin password' bun run db:seed && BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@example.test BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD='bootstrap admin password' sh scripts/ci/m1-proof.sh"
scripts.proof:m6:docker: docker compose up -d --wait mysql && docker compose exec -T mysql mysql -uapp -papp app -e "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ciprobe_widgets" && bun run modgen:ci && (bun run proof:m1:docker; rc=$?; bun run modgen:ci:clean; exit $rc)
scripts.scheduler:proof:docker: docker compose up -d --wait mysql && docker run --rm --network dashboard-ai-boilerplate_default --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD":/w -w /w -e DB_DIALECT=mysql -e DATABASE_URL=mysql://app:app@mysql:3306/app oven/bun:1.4 bun run scripts/scheduler-proof.ts
scripts.test:integration:docker: docker compose up -d --wait mysql && docker run --rm --network dashboard-ai-boilerplate_default --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD":/w -w /w -e DB_DIALECT=mysql -e DATABASE_URL=mysql://app:app@mysql:3306/app -e TABLE_PREFIX= -e INTEGRATION=1 oven/bun:1.4 sh -c "bun --env-file=/dev/null run bootstrap && bun --env-file=/dev/null run --cwd packages/db migrate && BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@example.test BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD='bootstrap admin password' bun --env-file=/dev/null run db:seed && bun --env-file=/dev/null test integration"
